definitions.explanation: A variety of everyday items and household goods, often including decorative items, stationery, and small accessories.

examples.japanese: {雑貨|ざっか}{屋|や}で{買|か}い{物|もの}をした。
examples.english: I went shopping at a general store.

examples.japanese: かわいい{雑貨|ざっか}を{集|あつ}めている。
クリスマスマーケットでは{手作|てづく}りの{雑貨|ざっか}や{温|あたた}かい{飲|の}み{物|もの}が{楽|たの}しめる。
examples.english: At Christmas markets, you can enjoy handmade goods and warm drinks.

notes:
{雑貨|ざっか} refers to various small everyday items, often with a focus on lifestyle and decorative goods.

WORD FORMATION:
{雑|ざつ} (miscellaneous) + {貨|か} (goods) = miscellaneous goods

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {雑貨|ざっか}{屋|や}: general store, variety shop
- {雑貨|ざっか}{店|てん}: miscellaneous goods store
- {生活|せいかつ}{雑貨|ざっか}: lifestyle goods, household items
- {輸入|ゆにゅう}{雑貨|ざっか}: imported goods
- {インテリア}{雑貨|ざっか}: interior décor items

NOTE:
In modern Japanese, {雑貨|ざっか} often has a positive connotation, referring to stylish or cute items rather than just "miscellaneous junk."
